# Colby Mainard — AI/ML Engineer & Personal Website

> Personal website and professional portfolio of Colby Mainard, an AI/Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and applied AI. He builds security-focused ML systems (fraud detection, anomaly detection, anti-money laundering) and applies AI to sports analytics, cybersecurity, and financial technology. The site documents his work history, education, projects, technical skills, certifications, technical opinions, beginner-friendly AI/ML guides, curated learning resources, and hobbies.

Colby Mainard is an AI/ML Engineer (currently at RiskScout). He holds a Master's in Computer Science from Texas A&M University — concentrating in artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision — and a B.S. in Computer Science from Texas A&M with minors in Business and Cybersecurity.

**Core expertise:** computer vision, deep learning, natural language processing, generative models (GANs, VAEs, transformers), reinforcement learning, and security-focused ML (fraud detection, anomaly detection, anti-money laundering).

**Primary tools & technologies:** Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, SQL, AWS, and Docker.

**Application domains:** sports analytics, cybersecurity, and financial technology (fintech).

**Canonical URL:** https://colbymainard.github.io/

**Last updated:** 2026-07-01

## Key facts

- **Site Author:** Colby Mainard
- **Role:** AI/Machine Learning Engineer
- **Current employer:** RiskScout
- **Education:** Masters and Bachelors of Science in Computer Science, Texas A&M University (graduate concentration in AI, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision; undergraduate minors in Business and Cybersecurity)
- **Specialties:** computer vision, deep learning, NLP, generative AI, reinforcement learning, and security/fraud ML
- **Site type:** static, client-side personal portfolio and technical-writing site

## Frequently asked questions

Colby Mainard is an AI/Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and applied AI. He currently works at RiskScout and holds Master's and Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science from Texas A&M University.

**What does Colby Mainard specialize in?**
Computer vision, deep learning, natural language processing, generative models (GANs, VAEs, transformers), reinforcement learning, and security-focused machine learning — including fraud detection, anomaly detection, and anti-money laundering.

**What can I find on Colby Mainard's website?**
His professional background (work history, education, projects, certifications, and technical skills), beginner-friendly guides to major technical domains, long-form technical opinion pieces, curated learning resources, and personal hobbies.

## Site notes

- Static site: client-side HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only — no backend, server-side processing, or API.
- Intended audience: potential colleagues, technical recruiters, fellow AI/ML enthusiasts, and computer science students.

## Pages

- [Home / Professional Background](https://colbymainard.github.io/index.html): Work history, education, projects, certifications, technical skills, and contact information.
- [Guides](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/guides.html): Plain-spoken starter guides for newcomers to data engineering, computer vision, generative AI, natural language processing, reinforcement learning, software engineering, and cybersecurity.
- [Technical Stances](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_takes.html): Long-form opinion pieces on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, cryptocurrency security, the future of quantum computing, AGI hype, post-internet privacy, and product placement in sports marketing.
- [Technical Resources](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_resources.html): Curated reading lists and learning resources covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, C/C++, Python, scripting, and operating systems.
- [Hobbies](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/hobbies.html): Photography, quantum-computing self-study, Dungeons & Dragons, and history.
